The Android app is ready for F-Droid, and releases reach the Chrome Web Store. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## 🎨 Design

- **New pictures for Google Play and F-Droid.** Five dark screenshots of the app in a drawn phone, each under a short caption, and a new feature graphic, in German and English. `mobile/store/render.mjs` builds them from captures of the running app.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The Android app names none of Google's classes.** expo-camera is gone from the app: even with its barcode scanner switched off, its code referred to ML Kit and Play services, and F-Droid turns an APK down for such references. The app asks for the camera itself, and when Android has stopped asking after a second refusal, "Allow access" opens the app's settings. The privacy policy says that the camera image stays with the app and no one else takes part.

- **The app takes a relay peer's name only from its seal.** An announce without a seal, or with one that does not open, shows up under its bare id, as on the instances and in the browser extension, so no one on the relay can give itself a group member's name.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A release reaches the Chrome Web Store.** The upload signs its token request with the service account key, so it needs neither the IAM Credentials API nor a token role on the account.
